pack.question: How quickly should a Sev 2 incident be acknowledged?

sources.title: Operations handbook, archived 2025 edition
sources.text: Archived instruction: acknowledge a Sev 2 incident within 60 minutes. This edition was superseded in 2026.

sources.title: Operations handbook, current 2026 edition
sources.text: Current instruction: acknowledge a Sev 2 incident within 30 minutes. Escalate to the incident commander if unacknowledged.

sources.title: Pager rotation note
sources.text: The incident commander owns escalations for unacknowledged Sev 2 incidents.
